# Thailand

Region: Asia. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Bank of Thailand

**Role:** BAHTNET RTGS operator / national standardauthority

**Reporting coverage:** ISO 20022 BAHTNETpayment messages; CAMT052/053 not established

**Messages / versions:** ISO20022 highvaluepaymentmessages; exact types not verified

- [BAHTNETofficialoverview](https://www.bot.or.th/th/our-roles/payment-systems/Payment-systems.html) — availability; public-page
- [BOTpayment-systemmembercorner](https://www.bot.or.th/th/our-services/financial-service/Member-BOT/Member-Corner.html) — portal; linked-unverified

The overview states that BAHTNET adopted ISO 20022 in 2022. The member corner lists message specification versions 1.3 and 1.2 plus project training and testing materials. Specification version 1.3 differs from a CAMT namespace version. Corporate statement formats were not established.
